entries.how: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

entries.name: Scatter Shot
entries.how: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.

entries.name: Barrage
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

entries.name: Mortal Shots
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

entries.name: Improved Serpent Sting
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

entries.name: Trueshot Aura
entries.how: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

entries.name: Rapid Killing
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Arcane Shot
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

entries.name: Lone Wolf
entries.how: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

entries.name: Careful Aim
entries.how: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Efficiency
entries.how: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

entries.name: Lethal Attacks
entries.how: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

entries.name: Improved Concussive Shot
entries.how: Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

entries.name: Hawk Eye
entries.how: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

entries.name: Unsealed Wrath
entries.how: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.how: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike.  Stacks up to 5 times.

entries.name: Repentance
entries.how: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

entries.name: Seal of Command
entries.how:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 140 to 141 Holy damage, 280 to 288 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

entries.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
entries.how: Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

entries.name: Eye for an Eye
entries.how: All critical strikes against you cause 10% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

entries.name: Pursuit of Justice
entries.how: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

entries.name: Sacred Arbiter
entries.how: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

entries.name: Sanctified Judgement
entries.how: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

entries.name: Vindication
entries.how: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 204 for 30 sec.

entries.name: Conviction
entries.how: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 6%.

entries.name: Holy Conduit
entries.how: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

entries.name: Improved Judgement
entries.how: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 2 sec.

entries.name: Benediction
entries.how: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.how: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

entries.name: Coup de Grace
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.

entries.name: Mutilate
entries.how: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 36 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

entries.name: Seal Fate
entries.how: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

entries.name: Improved Kidney Shot
entries.how: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

entries.name: Venom
entries.how: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Improved Poisons
entries.how: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

entries.name: Vile Poisons
entries.how: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

entries.name: Cold Blood
entries.how: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

entries.name: Lethality
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Expose Armor
entries.how: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

entries.name: Blood Splatter
entries.how: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec.

entries.name: Puncturing Wounds
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

entries.name: Vigor
entries.how: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

entries.name: Ruthlessness
entries.how: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

entries.name: Malice
entries.how: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

entries.name: Arcane Subtlety
entries.how: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

entries.name: Arcane Focus
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

entries.name: Improved Channeling
entries.how: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 20% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Accelerant
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Impact
entries.how: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

entries.name: Frost Warding
entries.how: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%, gives your Frost Ward a 0% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 0%.

entries.name: Improved Frostbolt
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

entries.name: Precision
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

entries.name: Wand Specialization
entries.how: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

entries.name: Thick Hide
entries.how: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 180 additional base Armor per level and another 1.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

entries.name: Brutal Impact
entries.how: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

entries.name: Feral Instinct
entries.how: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 1 level higher.

entries.name: Heart of the Wild
entries.how: Increases your Intellect by 10%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Ferocity
entries.how: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

entries.name: Moonkin Form
entries.how:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Moonfury
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.

entries.name: Dreamstate
entries.how: Your damaging non-periodic spell critical strikes grant you 50% of your mana regeneration while casting for 8 sec.

entries.name: Nature's Grace
entries.how: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.how: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by -0.03 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.

entries.name: Insect Swarm
entries.how: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 352 Nature damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Nature's Reach
entries.how: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

entries.name: Nature's Splendor
entries.how: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

entries.name: Improved Entangling Roots
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

entries.name: Nature's Majesty
entries.how: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 1%.

entries.name: Moonglow
entries.how: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

entries.name: Genesis
entries.how: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.

entries.name: Improved Wrath
entries.how: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

entries.name: Remorseless Attacks
entries.how: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries.how: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Weapon Expertise
entries.how: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

entries.name: Hack and Slash
entries.how:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

    Axe/Sword: Your successful
    melee attacks have a 5% chance
    to trigger an extra attack on the 
    target.

    Dagger/Fist: Increases your
    critical strike chance by 5%.

    Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of
    your target's armor.

entries.name: Blade Flurry
entries.how: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Aggression
entries.how: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 15%.

entries.name: Improved Sprint
entries.how: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

entries.name: Improved Kick
entries.how: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.how: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

entries.name: Endurance
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

entries.name: Precision
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

entries.name: Improved Slice and Dice
entries.how: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

entries.name: Flash of Steel
entries.how: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 15 and reduces its cooldown by 2.0 sec.

entries.name: Efficient Strikes
entries.how: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5.

entries.name: Improved Gouge
entries.how: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

entries.name: Premeditation
entries.how: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

entries.name: Dirty Deeds
entries.how: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

entries.name: Preparation
entries.how: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

entries.name: Heightened Senses
entries.how: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

entries.name: Hemorrhage
entries.how: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

entries.name: Improved Ambush
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

entries.name: Boot Knife
entries.how: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

entries.name: Setup
entries.how: Gives you a 45% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

entries.name: Serrated Blades
entries.how: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

entries.name: Elusiveness
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

entries.name: Ghostly Strike
entries.how: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth.  Awards 1 combo point.

entries.name: Initiative
entries.how: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

entries.name: Camouflage
entries.how: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

entries.name: Dirty Tricks
entries.how: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

entries.name: Composure
entries.how: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10.

entries.name: Opportunity
entries.how: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 20%.

entries.name: Master of Deception
entries.how: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

entries.name: Ice Barrier
entries.how: Shield yourself, absorbing 480 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Winter's Chill
entries.how: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

entries.name: Fingers of Frost
entries.how: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.name: Improved Cone of Cold
entries.how: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.how: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

entries.name: Ice Lance
entries.how: Deals 28 to 33 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

entries.name: Shatter
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

entries.name: Ice Block
entries.how: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

entries.name: Arctic Reach
entries.how: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Blizzard
entries.how: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

entries.name: Frost Channeling
entries.how: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.how: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

entries.name: Improved Frost Nova
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

entries.name: Permafrost
entries.how: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

entries.name: Ice Shards
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

entries.name: Precision
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Frost Warding
entries.how: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

entries.name: Combustion
entries.how: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

entries.name: Fire Power
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

entries.name: Blast Wave
entries.how: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 194 to 229 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Critical Mass
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

entries.name: Master of Elements
entries.how: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

entries.name: Heating Up
entries.how: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

entries.name: Improved Fire Ward
entries.how: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

entries.name: Improved Scorch
entries.how: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

entries.name: Burning Soul
entries.how: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

entries.name: Pyroblast
entries.how: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 412 to 448 Fire damage and an additional 236 Fire damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Impact
entries.how: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

entries.name: Flame Throwing
entries.how: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

entries.name: Ignite
entries.how: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

entries.name: Accelerant
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Incineration
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 10%.

entries.name: Improved Fire Blast
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

entries.name: Arcane Power
entries.how: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

entries.name: Arcane Instability
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

entries.name: Arcane Mind
entries.how: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

entries.name: Presence of Mind
entries.how: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Arcane Resilience
entries.how: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 75% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Arcane Meditation
entries.how: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Improved Counterspell
entries.how: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

entries.name: Arcane Shielding
entries.how: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

entries.name: Arcane Blast
entries.how: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 178 to 170 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

entries.name: Arcane Impact
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

entries.name: Arcane Geometry
entries.how: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

entries.how: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Arcane Concentration
entries.how: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

entries.name: Magic Absorption
entries.how: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

entries.name: Arcane Subtlety
entries.how: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

entries.name: Improved Channeling
entries.how: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Wand Specialization
entries.how: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

entries.name: Shadowform
entries.how: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

entries.name: Darkness
entries.how: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

entries.name: Devouring Contagion
entries.how:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

entries.name: Vampiric Embrace
entries.how: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

entries.name: Shadow Weaving
entries.how: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

entries.name: Dark Inspiration
entries.how: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Silence
entries.how: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

entries.name: Improved Mind Flay
entries.how: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 20% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

entries.name: Mind Flay

entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.

entries.name: Blackout

entries.name: Spirit Tap
entries.how: Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

entries.name: Penance
entries.how: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 105 Holy damage to an enemy, or 194 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

entries.name: Renewed Hope
entries.how: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

entries.name: Power Infusion
entries.how: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Mental Strength
entries.how: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

entries.name: Soul Warding
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

entries.name: Divine Aegis
entries.how: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Shields up to 1,200 damage and lasts 12 sec.

entries.name: Improved Inner Fire
entries.how: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

entries.name: Mental Agility
entries.how: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

entries.name: Meditation

entries.how: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

entries.how: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

entries.how: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 310 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

entries.name: Spiritual Healing
entries.how: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

entries.name: Spiritual Guidance
entries.how: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

entries.name: Spirit of Redemption
entries.how: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

entries.name: Litany of Light
entries.how: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

entries.name: Holy Binding
entries.how: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.

entries.name: Searing Light
entries.how: Increases your Holy damage done by 5%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

entries.name: Improved Healing
entries.how: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

entries.name: Working Overtime
entries.how: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 20%.

entries.name: Performance Bonus
entries.how: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

entries.name: Bartering
entries.how: Reduces the gold price of items from all vendors by 10%.

entries.name: Dedicated Study
entries.how: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.

entries.name: Bountiful Harvest
entries.how: You are 100% more likely to discover Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.

entries.name: Luremaster
entries.how: While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 50% chance to catch an extra fish.

entries.name: Master Chef
entries.how: Your cooking recipes have a 50% chance to create an extra result.

entries.name: Talented
entries.how: You gain talent points every level starting at level 9 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

entries.name: Frequent Flier
entries.how: You receive a 50% discount on all flight paths, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.

entries.name: Well Rested
entries.how: Your rested experience accumulates 20% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Field Guide
entries.how: Reduces your cooldown on adding Camp features by 25%

entries.name: Field Medicine
entries.how: Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 10 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

entries.name: High Alert
entries.how: Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 2. Ineffective in Battlegrounds.

entries.name: Thrill of Adventure
entries.how: You gain 5% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

entries.name: Bloodthrill
entries.how: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

entries.name: Overgrowth
entries.how: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

entries.name: Shadow Focus
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

entries.name: Holy Precision
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

entries.name: Power in Light
entries.how: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

entries.name: Holy Reach
entries.how: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.

entries.name: Inspiration
entries.how: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

entries.name: Blessed Recovery
entries.how: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

entries.name: Holy Nova
entries.how: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 61 to 65 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 82 to 91. These effects cause no threat.

entries.name: Divine Fury
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Spell Warding
entries.how: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

entries.name: Holy Specialization
entries.how: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.

entries.name: Improved Renew
entries.how: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

entries.name: Twilight Focus
entries.how: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Incinerate
entries.how: Deals 338 to 337 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

entries.name: Shadow and Flame
entries.how: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 20% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

entries.name: Bane of Havoc
entries.how: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Fire and Brimstone
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

entries.name: Pyroclasm
entries.how: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

entries.name: Agonizing Flames
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

entries.name: Conflagrate
entries.how: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 241 to 234 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

entries.name: Destructive Reach
entries.how: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

entries.name: Intensity
entries.how: Gives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Ruin
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

entries.name: Shadowburn
entries.how: Instantly blasts the target for 208 to 218 Shadow damage.  If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

entries.name: Molten Skin
entries.how: Reduces all damage taken by 10%.

entries.name: Aftermath
entries.how: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

entries.name: Cataclysm
entries.how: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

entries.name: Bane
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

entries.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
entries.how: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

entries.name: Demonic Pact
entries.how: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

entries.name: Master Demonologist
entries.how:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.how: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

entries.name: Demonic Knowledge
entries.how: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

entries.name: Improved Felhunter
entries.how: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

entries.name: Fel Domination
entries.how: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

entries.name: Demonic Brand
entries.how: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal 90 to 93 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

entries.name: Decimation
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

entries.name: Master Summoner
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

entries.name: Demonic Energies
entries.how: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

entries.name: Demonic Sacrifice
entries.how:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

entries.name: Improved Sayaad
entries.how: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

entries.name: Demonic Aegis
entries.how: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

entries.name: Fel Vitality
entries.how: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

entries.name: Improved Voidwalker
entries.how: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

entries.name: Improved Health Funnel
entries.how: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

entries.name: Unholy Power
entries.how: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

entries.name: Demonic Embrace
entries.how: Increases your total Stamina by 15%.

entries.name: Improved Imp
entries.how: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

entries.name: Wrack
entries.how: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 177 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Shadow Mastery
entries.how: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 10%.

entries.name: Soul Siphon
entries.how: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

entries.name: Siphon Life
entries.how: Transfers 27 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec.  Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Curse of Exhaustion
entries.how: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Nightfall
entries.how: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

entries.name: Amplify Curse
entries.how: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%.  Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Pandemic
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

entries.name: Fel Concentration
entries.how: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

entries.name: Improved Bane of Agony
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

entries.name: Improved Drains
entries.how: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Life Tap
entries.how: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

entries.name: Soul Harvest
entries.how: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Grim Reach
entries.how: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Corruption
entries.how: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

entries.name: Suppression
entries.how: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

entries.name: Improved Intercept
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

entries.name: Death Wish
entries.how: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.name: Flurry
entries.how: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.how: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Enrage
entries.how: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

entries.name: Improved Execute
entries.how: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

entries.name: Dual Wield Specialization
entries.how: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.

entries.name: Blood Craze
entries.how: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

entries.name: Piercing Howl
entries.how: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Unbridled Wrath
entries.how: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

entries.name: Booming Voice
entries.how: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces the Rage cost by of your Shouts and Howls by 25%.

entries.name: Cruelty
entries.how: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

entries.name: Mortal Strike
entries.how: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

entries.name: Improved Hamstring
entries.how: Gives your Hamstring ability a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

entries.name: Weaponmaster
entries.how:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

    Axe/Polearm: Increases your
    critical strike chance by 5%.

    Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore
    15% of your target's armor.

    Sword: Your successful melee 
    attacks have a 5% chance to 
    trigger an extra attack on the 
    target.

entries.name: Sweeping Strikes
entries.how: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

entries.name: Impale
entries.how: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

entries.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
entries.how: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

entries.name: Spearing Strike
entries.how: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

entries.name: Deep Wounds
entries.how: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 60% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

entries.name: Anger Management
entries.how: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

entries.name: Improved Overpower
entries.how: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

entries.name: Furious Precision
entries.how: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

entries.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
entries.how: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

entries.name: Improved Charge
entries.how: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

entries.name: Improved Rend
entries.how: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.how: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

entries.name: Improved Heroic Strike
entries.how: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 Rage.

entries.name: Shield Slam
entries.how: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

entries.name: Focused Rage
entries.how: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.how: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

entries.name: Improved Shield Bash
entries.how: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

entries.name: Improved Shield Wall
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11.0 min.

entries.name: Concussion Blow
entries.how: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.how: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

entries.name: Improved Disarm
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

entries.name: Improved Sunder Armor
entries.how: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

entries.name: Improved Revenge
entries.how: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.how: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

entries.name: Master of Defense
entries.how: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

entries.name: Improved Thunder Clap
entries.how: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

entries.name: Improved Bloodrage
entries.how: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.how: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

entries.name: Shield Specialization
entries.how: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

entries.name: Improved Whirlwind
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind ability by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals to the closest enemy by 30%.

entries.name: Improved Berserker Rage
entries.how: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.how: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

entries.name: Flawless Execution
entries.how: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.

entries.how: You gain talent points every level starting at level 6 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

entries.name: Talented
entries.how: You gain talent points every level starting at level 8 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

entries.name: Reinforce
entries.how: You take 40% less durability loss when you die.

entries.name: The Quick and the Dead
entries.how: Increases movement speed while dead by 10% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 2 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.

entries.name: Gourmand
entries.how: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 100%.

entries.name: Diplomat
entries.how: Increases your reputation gains by 10%.

entries.name: For Great Honor
entries.how: Increases Honor Points gained by 10%.

entries.name: Permanence
entries.how: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 100% longer.

entries.name: Reagent Economy
entries.how: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors.

entries.name: Improved Stings
entries.how: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

entries.how: Instantly convert 667 Mana into 40 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

entries.name: Arcane Wrath
entries.how: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 466 to 461 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

entries.name: Gore Drinker
entries.how: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, Reckless Swings, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

entries.name: Early Demise
entries.how: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

entries.name: Reverence
entries.how: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Malevolence
entries.how: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

entries.name: Swift Judgement
entries.how: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.

entries.name: Iron Creed
entries.how: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 30%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 6% for 6 sec.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries.how: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.how: Increases your Agility by 15%.

entries.name: Survivalist's Discipline
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

entries.name: Consecrated Ground
entries.how: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

entries.name: Infusion of Light
entries.how: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.

entries.name: Shield Specialization
entries.how: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana.  May only occur once every 3 sec.

entries.name: Shieldsworn
entries.how: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 4 sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for 6 sec.

Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:

entries.name: Improved Slam

entries.how: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

entries.how: Reduces the cast time of your Turn Undead spell by 1.0 sec, its cooldown by 10 sec, and allows it to affect Demons.
